scope_limitation: NON-CLINICAL ADMINISTRATIVE WORKFLOWS ONLY. No clinical decision-making, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, or patient health information processing without explicit human oversight and de-identification.
common_pain_points: Reception staff spending hours on phone and email triage
Manual appointment reminders not sent consistently
Referral documents filed inconsistently or lost
Billing and payment follow-up taking excessive time
Supply ordering reactive rather than proactive
Website FAQ content not kept current

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Classify incoming emails by type (appointment, referral, billing, general); route to appropriate staff; draft routine response for approval
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Reception staff reviews all drafted responses before sending; no clinical content in responses

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Automated SMS/email reminders at configurable intervals; manage responses (confirm, reschedule, cancel); flag no-responses for follow-up
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Practice manager approves reminder content and scheduling; no clinical information in reminders

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Classify incoming referrals by type; extract non-clinical metadata (referring doctor, date, type); file and notify appropriate staff
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Staff reviews classification and metadata extraction; no clinical content is processed or stored by AI

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Generate polite payment follow-up correspondence for outstanding accounts; staff reviews and sends
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Billing staff reviews all follow-up correspondence before sending; no patient health information included

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Help generate and update FAQ content based on common reception questions; practice manager reviews and approves
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Practice manager reviews all FAQ content before publishing; no clinical advice in FAQs

recommended_ai_patterns.description: Suggest roster options based on practitioner availability, session types and historical patterns; practice manager decides
recommended_ai_patterns.human_approval: Practice manager reviews and approves all roster decisions

software_categories: Practice management (MedicalDirector, Helix, Best Practice, Cliniko)
human_approval_points: ALL patient-facing communications must be approved by practice staff
ALL billing communications must be approved by billing staff
ALL recall actions must be approved by qualified clinical staff
NO clinical decisions, triage or priority-setting by AI
NO access to patient health records, Medicare data or clinical systems
NO sending of health information without explicit human approval and compliance review
Referral content must NOT be read, analysed or processed by AI — only administrative metadata
data_sensitivity: HIGH. Medical practices handle protected health information subject to Privacy Act 1988, My Health Records Act 2012, and potentially state health records legislation. This scan does NOT access, process or store any patient health information. Only non-clinical administrative workflows are assessed.
not_recommended_for_automation: Processing or analysing patient health records
Automatic appointment prioritisation based on clinical need
Any workflow that copies patient data out of certified practice management systems
Automated referral processing beyond basic administrative classification
Any system that bypasses security controls of MedicalDirector, Helix, Best Practice, Cliniko or similar
Processing Medicare numbers, patient identifiers or health fund details
Any workflow that could constitute a breach of My Health Records Act
strict_constraints: Patient names, dates of birth, Medicare numbers, health record numbers, test results and health conditions must NEVER be entered into this assessment or any AI system
All workflows are limited to non-clinical administrative processes
No AI system should replace the clinical judgment of qualified health professionals
Any future processing of real health data requires a separate privacy impact assessment, architecture review and potentially new vendor contracts
Practice management system boundaries must be respected — AI tools work alongside, not inside, certified clinical systems
onsite_discovery_questions: Walk us through how reception handles a typical day's email and phone enquiries
How are appointment reminders currently sent?
What is the process for receiving, filing and actioning referral documents?
How does billing follow-up work for outstanding accounts?
How is the staff roster managed?
What practice management system do you use and what are its automation capabilities?
What are the biggest time sinks for your administrative (non-clinical) staff?
What compliance requirements affect your administrative workflows?
pilot_scope_examples: AI-triage reception emails for one week (draft responses only, staff approves all)
Automated appointment reminders for one practitioner's sessions
Non-clinical referral document classification (admin metadata only, no clinical content)
Billing follow-up draft generation for accounts over 30 days outstanding
cannot_promise: Compliance with Privacy Act 1988, My Health Records Act or any health-specific regulation
That AI workflows will handle patient data securely without further assessment
Integration with certified practice management systems
That automated administrative workflows will not require further privacy review
Processing of any health information within acceptable risk bounds without a separate assessment
reduction_range_assumption: 15%–40% of current manual hours on NON-CLINICAL administrative workflows only
